summary: Spec review of Amendment 1 (Phase 3b, FR-14 and D16 to D28) at HEAD ffd9971c. The amendment serves Daniel's request of 2026-11-06: each day carries one parent-share moment that shows a child using English, the sticker step is not a share moment, the moment adds 0 minutes, the student book stays unchanged, and the Thai goes to Daniel only. The moment table matches the shipped week files: A3, B5, C4, D4 and D5, D6, and w08 A2, B1, C1, D1, E3, with B6, D5, and D6 marked moved, so check rules 2 and 3 hold. The icon counts (6 for a teach week, 5 for w08) follow the table. The Monorepo contract claim holds at HEAD f97fffbaf: scriptSchema is passthrough, receiveWeek writes the source text unchanged, and mediaPathsOf plus phase3-media-coverage.test.ts forbid a media path in the share field. The warn window does not break the print track: check-weeks.ts exits 1 on a FAIL only, and the content lands before the switch. No Blocker found. Four nonblocking findings: one Major (unnamed caption-list cross-check) and three Nits (lint excludes the new fixture, no word counter named, stale Monorepo pin).
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] spec.md FR-14 "The caption list" and plan.md Phase 3b caption-list task (AC-14.10): the cross-check command is unnamed and no script file is named, so a second role cannot reproduce the gate that each row matches the week files and i18n.ts. Rationale: the plan says "Run a cross-check command that compares each row with the week files and the labels, and record the command and its exit code in this task", so the gate rests on a command that the maker writes at run time; AC-14.10 states "A cross-check command compares each row ... and it exits 0" without a path or a shape, and the reviewer or the orchestrator cannot re-run it from the track documents.

F2 [Nit] plan.md Phase 3b Red task (fixtures): the new file __tests__/fixtures/storytime-share-sample.ts is not covered by PROJECT_LINT, which reads only lib/storytime, scripts/storytime, and __tests__/storytime-loops-*.test.ts. Rationale: Phase 1 recorded the same gap and added its fixture to the lint run by hand (plan.md line 110), and this phase repeats no such step, so a lint error in the sample file reaches a commit unseen.

F3 [Nit] spec.md FR-14 rule 6: "caption.en has 1 to 40 words" names no word counter. Rationale: no word-count helper exists in dashboard/lib/storytime or dashboard/lib/text-profile at HEAD ffd9971c, so two implementers can count the same caption differently; the limit stays at the rule level and the Red author picks the counter in the test.

F4 [Nit] spec.md "Interface for the Storytime app (Monorepo)": the text names HEAD db3fc23d8, and the repository HEAD is f97fffbaf. Rationale: every claim rechecked at f97fffbaf (scriptSchema passthrough at lines 381 to 391, receiveWeek at line 218, the parse at 222, the unchanged write at 237, mediaPathsOf at 191, phase3-media-coverage.test.ts) holds at both commits, so the stale pin costs no work and only weakens the evidence line.

paraphrase.proposes: Amendment 1 adds Phase 3b to this track: one parent-share moment on each day of each Level 2 week. The teacher films or photographs a child who uses English, at a named step, and posts the shot with one caption in English and Thai in the closed class parent group. The change is additive: schema.ts gets the optional strict field scripts[].share with 1 or 2 shots (step, photo or video) and one BiText caption; checks.ts gets the check share-moment with the exported constant SHARE_CHECK_STATUS, which is warn until the switch task and fail after it; manual.ts prints one inline camera or video icon, the label, and the caption at each shot step when the option share is on, and the two print scripts get the --share flag; the week files w01 to w08 get the share of each script. The build of 2026-11-12 goes to ~/Desktop/print-ready/storytime/share-check-v1/teacher-book/, and the caption list share-captions-11-16.md holds 40 caption rows and 4 label rows for Daniel's sitting of 2026-11-16. The moment adds 0 minutes, the student book stays unchanged, and Daniel is the only reader of the Thai.
paraphrase.current_system: The system holds eight Level 2 week files in content/storytime/l2/, parsed by StorytimeWeekSchema and checked by checkStorytimeWeek through check-weeks.ts. Each week has five daily scripts with fixed step ids and minutes, and some steps carry moved next-opening, so a step of day N runs in the opening of day N+1. The teacher book is built from manual.ts by make-manual-pdf.ts and make-teacher-book-print.ts, with the loops behind the --loops flag, and the print file of one unit holds one level and one unit at a time. The Monorepo Storytime app reads the weeks through a passthrough contract, so an unknown script field reaches the app without a contract change, and a string that ends in a media extension must stay out of the week unless the media list covers it. The student book, the readers, and the covers take no input from the new field.
